BL-1386 — The reconcile sweep never orphans a merge it started: an abort that fails is retried and logged, the daemon records which MERGE_HEAD is its own and aborts it next tick, and the real reason a merge failed is logged instead of the word conflict
What it solves: `required_wiring` anchors 1 and 2 are the daemon's own new literals, but
`handoffd.bb` is the pre-existing live consumer of `absorb-with-merge!`
and the only process that can emit that log line or write that record,
so a parcel that changes the lib and forgets the daemon adapters fails
both. The BL…
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. This is the creator half of the poisoned merge the coordinator asked me to mint (evidence backlog/evidence/main-sync-poisoned-merge-authorship-blind-20260904.md); the detector half is BL-1387…
